# Minimalism Life

> A comprehensive resource hub for understanding and practicing minimalism across lifestyle, design, and philosophy.

Minimalism Life provides curated content, products, and community resources for intentional living. Founded by Leo Babauta and contributors like The Minimalists, the platform connects minimalism philosophy with practical tools, design inspiration, and personal stories from practitioners worldwide.

## Key Topics

- minimalism
- intentional living
- simple living
- decluttering
- minimalism philosophy
- sustainable living
- personal growth
- digital wellness
- minimal design
- less is more
- lifestyle design
- community
- Leo Babauta
- The Minimalists
- tools and resources

## Foundation & Philosophy

- [What is minimalism?](https://minimalism.com/what-is-minimalism): Foundational guide explaining minimalism philosophy across art, design, and lifestyle practices.
- [Manifesto](https://minimalism.com/manifesto): Mission statement defining Minimalism Life as collaborative resource hub spanning art, design, lifestyle.
- [What are the benefits?](https://minimalism.com/what-are-the-benefits): Guide exploring minimalism benefits including stress reduction, financial gains, and creativity.
- [Who is minimalism for?](https://minimalism.com/who-is-minimalism-for): Guide helping professionals, students, and artists understand how minimalism applies to their lives.

## Lifestyle & Living

- [Minimal lifestyle](https://minimalism.com/lifestyle): Lifestyle resources hub featuring books, podcasts, and tools for simple living by Leo Babauta and others.
- [Journal](https://minimalism.com/journal): Personal essays and community stories from Paul Ruth, Carl Phillips, and others on minimalist living.

## Design & Aesthetics

- [Minimal design](https://minimalism.com/design): Design resources and curated minimal tools including Artifacts, Zeitgeist, and aesthetic inspiration.

## Products & Shop

- [Shop](https://minimalism.com/shop): E-commerce store offering minimalist products from Void Watches, Barebones, and other curated brands.

## Getting Started

- [Minimalism Life - Home](https://minimalism.com): Homepage introducing minimalism principles, lifestyle resources, and curated minimalist products.

## Optional

- [Privacy and terms](https://minimalism.com/privacy): Privacy policy and terms of service covering GDPR compliance and data retention practices.
